issues.explanation: IssueTicket calls now() twice so code day and issued_at/issue_date can split at midnight, violating read-clock-once requirement.
TicketFactory defaults issue_date to today instead of the date of issued_at, so custom issued_at rows are misaligned and daily scoping is wrong.
Queue model has no saving validation throwing InvalidArgumentException and no empty-map-to-null normalization on every save.
Migration makes issue_date non-nullable with Postgres-only ALTER COLUMN SET NOT NULL swallowed for SQLite, leaving the column nullable in tests.
Required doc updates to docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md are absent from the diff.
Ticket::nextCode now requires three args and factory passes a date-cast object, breaking backward compatibility and risking a TypeError.
Existing create_queues migration edited to add priority_prefix_map instead of creating a new migration with make:migration.
Migration uses hand-written raw DB::statement instead of Blueprint change() and swallows failure, against generated-migration and sibling-style rules.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite test-first requirement for every feature.
priority_prefix_map added to Fillable although task says it is not mass-assignable and must change only through UpdateQueue, bypassing validation.
UpdateQueue duplicates the default map literal instead of reusing Queue::DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP.
Added IssueTicket lines are mis-indented relative to surrounding lock transaction block.

review.summary: Change implements prefix resolution and daily per-prefix sequencing but breaks the clock-once rule, factory date alignment, model-level validation/normalization, mass-assignment guard, migration nullability, docs and tests, needing substantial rework before merge.
